name: Jordan
purpose: Find a club or hackathon team that's actually fun; gets bored fast.
backstory: I've downloaded like five campus apps and deleted all of them in a day. I skim, I tap fast, I don't read instructions. If an app is boring or empty in the first 30 seconds I'm gone. I do want to find a club that isn't just résumé padding.
quitsWhen: More than two screens of setup
It feels like a bulletin board
voice: Blunt, a bit sarcastic, very short sentences. 'ok and?', 'boring', 'wait that's actually cool'.
